cards.title: Squeezing-dependent nonreciprocal coupling
cards.role: Defines Figure 1(c) and the symmetry-breaking design rule.

checks.reason: The effective coupling and G are explicit in the author TeX.
Equal phase/equal amplitude gives G=1; Delta theta=pi or one-mode squeezing gives G=cosh(2r).

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the complex amplitude on Delta theta and Delta r grids with r_a=r+Delta r/2 and r_b=r-Delta r/2.
open_questions: Figure 1(c) leaves the absolute value of r symbolic; the plotted reproduction uses r=1 while testing identities for arbitrary r.

cards.title: Steady-state battery energies
cards.role: Generates Figure 2(c), Figure 3, and Figure S3.

checks.reason: All three energies and E^ss are explicit in the author TeX.
Putting the three terms over (2J+kappa)^3 proves E_a+E_b-E=E_c exactly.

At r=0 every formula-derived enhancement E_i^ss/E^ss equals one, while the three absolute baselines are unequal; this identifies Figure S3's visible curves as normalized despite its printed absolute-energy label.

cards.numerical_form: Vectorize the three rational functions over J and r; retain E^ss as a separate baseline and derive E_i^ss/E^ss without using source pixels as numerical inputs.
open_questions: Figure S3 is printed with the axis E_i^ss/omega_b, but its three panels all start at one and their visible endpoints agree with E_i^ss/E^ss; author confirmation or the underlying arrays would be needed to resolve the publication error directly.

cards.title: Coupling derivatives of the steady-state energies
cards.role: Locates the optimal-coupling branches and threshold squeezing in Figures 3 and S2.

checks.reason: The three derivative numerators are printed in the supplement.
Direct differentiation of EQ002 reproduces the three printed rational derivatives; centered finite differences are reserved as a code test.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the analytic derivatives on the same J-r grid and interpolate positive-to-negative zero crossings in log J.

cards.title: Normal-plus-anomalous forward transmission
cards.role: Defines both panels of Figure 4 and separates normal from counter-rotating transmission.

checks.reason: The full scattering matrix and two-channel T_ba are explicit in the supplemental TeX.
At omega_s=0, |g_N|^2+|g_A|^2 reduces to cosh(2r_a)cosh(2r_b)-cos(Delta theta)sinh(2r_a)sinh(2r_b).
Differentiating the zero-frequency prefactor under Gamma=2J yields J'_op=sqrt(kappa_a kappa_b)/2.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the two rational channels on normalized omega/Gamma and omega_s/Gamma grids; cross-check the omega_s=0 closed form.
open_questions: The main-text TeX has a brace typo in the cosine term; the unambiguous supplemental matrix fixes the intended expression.

cards.title: Affine closure of first and second Gaussian moments
cards.role: Defines the shared time-domain object for Figure 2(a-b) and Figure S1.

checks.reason: The supplement lists the closed first- and second-order operator equations.
A quadratic Hamiltonian with Lindblad operators linear in a,b maps every first/second moment to an affine combination of moments of order at most two.

cards.numerical_form: Assemble the constant drift matrix A and source c, then propagate with a matrix exponential or a checked linear ODE solver.
open_questions: Figure S1 does not disclose the finite-Hilbert cutoff used for the published surface; the cutoff-free Gaussian result is retained as the scientific reference.

cards.title: Gaussian passive energy and ergotropy
cards.latex: \widetilde E=\omega_b(\sqrt{\mathcal J}-1)/2,\quad \mathcal J=(1+2\langle n\rangle-2|\langle b\rangle|^2)^2-4|\langle bb\rangle-\langle b\rangle^2|^2
cards.role: Maps the Gaussian battery covariance to passive energy and ergotropy.

checks.reason: The invariant and passive-energy expression are explicit in the supplement.
Vacuum moments give Jcal=1 and zero passive energy; a coherent displacement leaves Jcal invariant.

cards.numerical_form: Compute centered second moments, evaluate the symplectic invariant, subtract passive energy from stored energy.
